digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center transport adapter / TicketTransport protocol
propositions: The DC transport lacks twelve members the core reaches for, causing AttributeError crashes and silent degradation when call sites swallow exceptions

Most missing members are silently swallowed at call sites, producing convergent-looking runs that skip comments, links, parents, and property syncs—the crash on set_entity_property was the lucky case that exposed the gap
The port describes 40% of what the core requires; full implementation of all twelve members with proper error handling and observability is needed to avoid moving the crash deeper
DC's reporter field uses 'name' not 'accountId', but _identity_of reads only accountId, causing reporter mutations to re-emit forever even after successful writes, breaking idempotence

Transport member absence is currently not detectable at construction because TicketTransport lacks @runtime_checkable, so missing members fail at runtime call sites months later instead of at backend build time

set_parent on DC must branch by parent type since epic membership uses Greenhopper's add_issues_to_epic endpoint while sub-tasks use fields.parent, requiring agile_rest_path='greenhopper' configuration
